passive.name: Sweet Dream
passive.text: Increases the wearer's provided Shield Effect by **12/15/18/21/24%**. While an ally target has a Shield, their DMG dealt increases by **12/14/16/18/20%**.

passive.name: Verdict
passive.text: Increases the wearer's DEF by **24/28/32/36/40%** and Effect Hit Rate by **24/28/32/36/40%**. Increases the chance for the wearer to be attacked by enemies. When the wearer is attacked, increase their DEF by an extra **24/28/32/36/40%** until the end of the wearer's turn.

weapons.name: Day One of My New Life

passive.name: At This Very Moment
passive.text: Increases the wearer's DEF by **16/18/20/22/24%**. After entering battle, increases All-Type RES of all allies by **8/9/10/11/12%**. Abilities of the same type cannot stack.

passive.name: Time Fleets Away
passive.text: The wearer is more likely to be attacked, and DMG taken is reduced by **16/18/20/22/24%**.

passive.name: Treasure
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Effect RES by **8/10/12/14/16%**. If the wearer is attacked and has no Shield, they gain a Shield equal to **16/20/24/28/32%** of their Max HP for **2** turn(s). This effect can only be triggered once every **3** turn(s). If the wearer has a Shield when attacked, the DMG they receive decreases by **12/15/18/21/24%**.

passive.name: A New Round of Shuffling
passive.text: Increases the wearer's DEF by **16/20/24/28/32%**. When the wearer is attacked, there is a **100/105/110/115/120%** base chance to Burn the enemy. For each turn, the wearer deals DoT that is equal to **40/50/60/70/80%** of the wearer's DEF for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Fist of Conviction
entries.text: Deals Ice DMG equal to **100%** of Gepard's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Daunting Smite
entries.text:
Deals Ice DMG equal to **200%** of Gepard's ATK to one designated enemy, with a **65%** base chance to Freeze the enemy for **1** turn(s).
While Frozen, the enemy cannot take action and will take Ice Additional DMG equal to **60%** of Gepard's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

entries.name: Enduring Bulwark
entries.text: Applies a Shield to all allies, absorbing DMG equal to **45%** of Gepard's DEF plus **600** for **3** turn(s).

entries.name: Unyielding Will
entries.text: When struck with a killing blow, instead of becoming knocked down, Gepard's HP immediately restores to **50%** of his Max HP. This effect can only trigger once per battle.

entries.name: Comradery
entries.text: After Gepard uses his Technique, when the next battle begins, a Shield will be applied to all allies, absorbing DMG equal to **24%** of Gepard's DEF plus **150** for **2** turn(s).

entries.name: Integrity
entries.text: Gepard has a higher chance to be attacked by enemies.

entries.name: Commander
entries.text: When "Unyielding Will" is triggered, Gepard's Energy will be restored to 100%.

entries.name: Grit
entries.text: Gepard's ATK increases by **35%** of his current DEF. This effect will refresh at the start of each turn.

entries.name: Due Diligence
entries.text: When using Skill, increases the base chance to Freeze the attacked target enemy by 35%.

entries.name: Lingering Cold
entries.text: After an enemy Frozen by Skill is unfrozen, their SPD is reduced by 20% for 1 turn(s).

entries.name: Never Surrender
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Faith Moves Mountains
entries.text: When Gepard is in battle, all allies' Effect RES increases by 20%.

entries.name: Cold Iron Fist
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Unyielding Resolve
entries.text: When his Talent is triggered, Gepard immediately takes action and restores extra HP equal to 50% of his Max HP.
